content: {"rules": ["Forecast models consistently overestimate prices in early cycles and underperform in late cycles.", "Sentiment peaks correlate with forecast overshoots, suggesting sentiment drives short-term price spikes.", "Model bias toward higher prices persists despite true outcomes showing mean-reversion toward lower levels.", "Forecast lags behind true price movements by 3–5 days, indicating delayed reaction to sentiment shifts.", "High sentiment positivity precedes forecast overestimation, suggesting sentiment amplifies model bias.", "True outcomes often dip below forecast mid-cycle, indicating model fails to capture downward momentum.", "Sentiment negativity in late cycles correlates with forecast underperformance, suggesting sentiment dampens model confidence.", "Model forecasts should adjust downward when sentiment turns negative or price shows early mean-reversion signals."]}
